newsitem.title: INDIA: Kashmir hostage families ask guerrillas for help.
newsitem.headline: Kashmir hostage families ask guerrillas for help.

text.p: The families of two Britons kidnapped nearly two years ago in Kashmir appealed on Wednesday to a leading guerrilla alliance for news of their loved ones.

"In particular, we appeal to Shoura-e-Jihad and Harkat-ul-Ansar to help us, please tell us the truth," Bob Wells, father of British hostage Paul Wells, told a news conference in Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir state.
The Shoura-e-Jihad is a pro-Pakistan alliance of seven leading separatist guerrilla groups in divided Kashmir, two-thirds of which is controlled by India and the remainder Pakistan.
The guerrilla groups include the Harkat-ul-Ansar, which Indian authorities and foreign missions say backed the kidnapping of the Westerners in July 1995 by the shadowy Al-Faran guerrilla group.
Harkat-ul-Ansar denies any ties with Al-Faran and last week issued its own appeal for the hostages' release.

Britons Paul Wells and Keith Mangan were abducted by Al-Faran while trekking through the Himalayas. German Dirk Hasert, Norwegian Hans Christian Ostroe, and Americans Donald Hutchings and John Childs were also captured.
Childs escaped but Ostroe was later found beheaded. There has been no trace of the other four for several months, raising doubts over whether they are still alive.

"See the chapter Yusuf in the Koran. Hazrat Yaqoob lost his eyesight due to the kidnapping of his son Hazrat Yusuf. I too have lost sight of my son, Paul, please help me to see the truth in the name of Allah," Bob Wells said.

Wells was accompanied by his son's girlfriend, Catherine Moseley, Mangan's wife, Julie, and a cousin. The four Britons have met senior police, government officials and separatist leaders in the Himalayan state.
"We know now that Al-Faran was a splinter group of Harkat-ul-Ansar, so we need to ask them for their help," said Julie Mangan, a 35-year-old school teacher.

"Someone somewhere knows the truth, we need that truth. I will return again in the months of June and July. If the answer can not be found now, I pray the answer will be here waiting on my next visit."
